item.title: PCSO announces lotto draw schedule this Christmas 2025, New Year
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced the schedule of selling and actual lotto draws for the 2025 Christmas season. Similar to previous year, the PCSO this year opted to have regular selling and draw operations on Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day.
